sources.method: Preserve the literal order in RCGS DEVICE0000515 (https://collection.rcgs.jp/page/DEVICE0000515) and multiply each centimetre value by 10. These are unlabelled millimetre values, not assigned width/height/depth axes. The source does not label the device axes. Game Cataloging Manual v1.00 p.24 (https://www.rcgs.jp/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/manual_ver100.pdf) describes package/carrier dimensions; its Device chapter p.49 is under drafting, so it does not establish this device's axis order.

notes: Exact catalogued physical specimen DEVICE0000515, not a universal DOL-003 model envelope, a retail stock code, manufacturing revision or proof of inclusion with a console. The museum names DOL-003, black and MADE IN JAPAN; its only stated information source is the physical device (装置現物). Market region and manufacture date are unresolved.

The catalogue size 10 * 14 * 6 cm is preserved verbatim. Only cm-to-mm conversion in unchanged literal order is derived; the axes remain unknown. The previously assigned catalogued width/height/depth state was withdrawn because the manual's p.24 convention concerns packages/carriers, while its Device chapter p.49 is under drafting. Pose/orientation, projection inclusion and cable arrangement are unpublished. No labelled dimensional state is supplied.

Family remains null until a generator supports the source identity, verified axes and measurement scope. No traced controller outline, controls, internals, cable length, connector geometry or physical-fit claim is supplied. The generic nintendo-gamecube-controller object is unchanged.

RCGS DEVICE0000438 reports 6.7 × 13.5 × 11 cm, while DEVICE0000515 reports 10 × 14 × 6 cm for another black DOL-003 specimen. The reason for the differing extents/pose/rounding is unresolved; neither is silently preferred or merged into the other. This record retains its own catalogue extent. The modern Wii U/Switch-era DOL-003 manual does not establish the original 2001 pack-in dimensions.

Reported precision is retained: no conversion adds a manufacturing tolerance or a digit absent from the source. No complete bundled/contents relationship is asserted for RCGS DEVICE0000404 or any retail GameCube pack.
